Your weekly briefing on the cutting edge of technology

This edition captures AI's split personality: simultaneously the sharpest new weapon in an attacker's toolkit and the thing regulators, researchers, and everyday users are scrambling to keep in check. From an AI model helping researchers breach OpenAI's own staff accounts to state-sponsored hackers exploiting old-fashioned social engineering at industrial scale, the security stakes keep rising. Meanwhile, policymakers and insiders alike are asking whether we're moving fast enough—or in the right direction—to keep pace with what we've built.
